chunks: And Ḥafṣ, Jamīl, and others narrated from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:
Regarding a person in ihram who trims from some [of the hair] and does not trim from some, he said: “It suffices him.”

key_terms.مُحْرِمٍ: a person in the state of ihram
key_terms.يُجْزِيهِ: it is sufficient for him and fulfills the requirement

ai.seo_question: Is it sufficient for a muhrim to trim only some of the hair in taqsir?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning taqsir for a person in ihram. It indicates that trimming part of the hair is sufficient, and complete trimming of all of it is not required for validity.
